title: Lamb Tagine with Indian Spices
description: A spicy lamb tagine dish with North Indian flavors, slow-cooked in a traditional clay pot. The lamb is tender and flavorful, with a rich sauce made from a blend of warming spices.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder
ingredients.amount: 1 pound, boneless and cut into 2-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: You can use lamb shanks or chops if you prefer

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the tagine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot over couscous or rice.
Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
